findings.symptom: The title shows x^2 with a literal caret rather than a superscript.

findings.suggested_repair: Render z^5 as inline math in the title or spell out “z to the fifth power”.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** shift the convex Ahlfors–Shimizu potential to the logarithmic variable; a bounded ratio on an unbounded sequence and the convexity chord bound force $T=O(\log r)$, which the rational characterization converts into a contradiction with transcendence.
findings.symptom: The uppercase proof-technique banner exposes literal dollar delimiters around T=O(log r); the rest of the math in the statement/proof renders normally.
findings.suggested_repair: Use plain text such as “T is O(log r)” in the banner or the banner field’s supported math syntax.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** induction on the weight $k$ in steps of $12$.
findings.symptom: The uppercase proof-technique banner exposes literal dollar delimiters around k and 12.
findings.suggested_repair: Use plain text “induction on the weight k in steps of 12” or the banner field’s supported math syntax.
